title: Oozy Dense Vietnamese Pork Bun Rieu
description: A buttery, dense, meal-prep Vietnamese dish featuring red chilli powder and beurre-monte, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional bun rieu, cooked to perfection in a wok.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the sliced shallots and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the pork shoulder pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the red chilli powder, fish sauce, lime juice, rice vinegar, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Add the beurre-monte and stir until it is fully incorporated and the sauce is smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the cooked rice noodles and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the bun rieu hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
